description: This file defines an immutable Java class 'ImmutableInfoProvider' that implements the 'ConnectionMonitor.InfoProvider' interface. It provides encapsulation for connection info such as correlation ID, timestamp, optional thing ID, headers, and payload supplier, with methods for accessing these properties and common object behaviors.

classes.name: ImmutableInfoProvider
classes.description: An immutable implementation of the ConnectionMonitor.InfoProvider interface, encapsulating connection metadata such as correlation ID, timestamp, optional thing ID, headers, payload supplier, and emptiness status.

methods.name: getCorrelationId
methods.description: Returns the correlation ID associated with this info provider.

methods.name: getTimestamp
methods.description: Returns the timestamp indicating when the info was captured.

methods.name: getThingId
methods.description: Returns the optional ThingId associated with the info, or null if not applicable.

methods.name: getHeaders
methods.description: Returns an unmodifiable map of headers associated with the info.

methods.name: getPayload
methods.description: Returns the payload string provided by the supplier, delaying actual retrieval until needed.

methods.name: isEmpty
methods.description: Indicates whether the info provider contains any meaningful data.
